body:
Hi, 


Sorry for letting you wait so long.
I think you were running into a bug with on chain that could lead to a stuck pending quote. This issue is already resolved. 

I just started rewriting the restore flow to preserve the old database. 

For your specific case, I will try to reconstruct this locally and provide a dedicated restore flow that is able to restore pending locked quotes that were never minted. 

I'm sure we will get this resolved. 

I will return to you once additional updates are available.

Thank you, that's great to hear, and no worries about the wait.

To save you some digging, here's what I have from the mint:
quote_id: 01a0a967-3833-76a3-8d57-3a9e054383a9

Hi @BTCdad69, 

are you using iOS or android? we recently fixed an issue with pending quotes. you should be able to mint these transactions with the latest version.

If the transactions are still stuck, please provide more information so we can resolve the issue.

thanks for the quote_id. we are working on an updated restore flow.

It might take a couple of days to finish. I'll keep you updated here.
